description: Is WAN deflationary? WAN emission (PoS rewards, each day counted from the block that pays it) and WAN burned (every WAN sent to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD, where Wanchain's Convert n' Burn programme sends it) over the last 30 days and the last 12 months, with burn divided by emission, read live from OrbitWan's own node. The orbitwan.io homepage card shows both windows and opens on the 12 months.
name: get_wan_deflation
title: WAN emission and burn
